goal: Restore read-only scheduled abandonment audit required-check evidence when the workflow token cannot read branch protection directly
prohibited_actions: Do not read or change database claims or leases
Do not mutate database or infrastructure
assumptions: GitHub's branch GET with Contents:read exposes the same branch-protection required contexts as the Administration:read endpoint
Metadata:read exposes effective branch rules and the repository currently has none
Post-merge main workflow proof remains on issue #3541 and is not claimed by a pre-merge completion report
stop_conditions: Stop if branch readback omits protection contexts or active rules cannot be reconciled
Stop if the fix requires a new credential or weakens the audit's exit-3 refusal
Stop if protected-source collision cannot be serialized
